profile.headline: Software engineer | Civil engineer | Bim | 3d three.js | IA | Entrepeneur
profile.summary:
Passionate about applying informatics in civil engineering.

INNOVATION | ENGINEERING  | CAD - GIS - BIM - WEB 3D | DISRUPTIVE TECHNOLOGIES

Since a programmable calculator fell into my hands until today, I have always believed that there are mechanisms to design / calculate civil engineering infrastructures in a simple, powerful and even fun way.

After working in several important companies, from earthworks to engineering studies, I arrive at  the best place where my profile had a place: Buhodra Ingeniería, where I was able to promote interesting changes in the interface, implement application of roads standards, generate adequate training documentation and help design the workflow of the 3D part of Istram (c).

Finally I discover html5 / wegbl and I realize that a new world opens up to do 3D things related to civil engineering with a simple web browser and I founded Civigner, managing for more than 5 years to raise funds from grants, credits and private investors to maintain a team of 4 development engineers and create something almost similar to what multinational companies in the sector are developing. The difference is only made by the amount of resources.

I think I've been lucky being able to be a user and later a developer of applications for civil engineering. My last stage as an entrepreneur has strengthened me professionally with skills associated with the management of a human team, and also to lead a small company.
